create_translator: create a Translator instance with a Unity model, vocoder, device, and optional text tokenizer
run_translator_predict: run the Translator.predict method to translate speech or text across languages with configurable generation options
get_prediction_from_model: get prediction from a UnitYModel using text and unit tokenizers with configurable beam search and ngram filtering
parse_task_string_to_modalities: parse a task string like S2ST or T2TT into source and target Modality pairs
apply_mintox_toxicity_mitigation: apply mintox toxicity mitigation to translation outputs by checking and replacing bad words in source and target text
